auth_ownership: LLD-12 supplies authenticated local-admin session and anti-forgery context; LLD-10 consumes it and never implements credential/session policy.
rules: client navigation routes are defined separately in ui/client-routes.json and never enter /api/v1
route adapters bind/validate DTOs only; working-copy command/query handlers own persistence logic
domain edit saves use their owning packet routes rather than an LLD-10 proxy
